Requested output columns: method_name (string).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. The only available table, untested_public_symbols, stores each symbol once with a short name, a qualified name that includes the enclosing scope (the class), and a kind. gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.name AS method_name
FROM code.symbols m
JOIN code.symbols c ON c.kind = 'class' AND c.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name
WHERE m.kind = 'method'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols m2
    JOIN code.symbols c2 ON c2.kind = 'class' AND c2.name = 'DatabricksDatabase' AND m2.file_id = c2.file_id AND m2.qualname = c2.qualname || '.' || m2.name
    WHERE m2.kind = 'method' AND m2.name = m.name)
ORDER BY method_name;
